prompts.welcome: Use case: illustration-story. Create a production sprite atlas for a Chinese child's English vocabulary app. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells on a square canvas. Soft warm children's storybook cartoon illustration, friendly children, cream backgrounds, clear simple silhouettes. No borders, no gutters, no text or letters anywhere, no English word labels, no watermarks. Each illustration stays entirely within its own cell with 12% empty padding so cells can be cropped by code. Reading order left-to-right top-to-bottom, one distinct scene per cell: 1 child walking toward a school with a simple arrow pointing toward school (to); 2 child waving hello (hi); 3 a child pointing to himself beside a simple portrait of himself to suggest identity (be); 4 two children pointing to themselves together to suggest 'we are' (are); 5 two children waving goodbye while one walks away (goodbye); 6 exactly one apple in center with a child holding it (an); 7 child stretching by a window at sunrise (morning); 8 friendly adult female teacher greeting the viewer (Ms); 9 child standing upright full-body (stand); 10 child rising from a chair with upward movement arrow (stand up); 11 hands closing a book (close); 12 child pointing with index finger at a red ball (point); 13 child cupping ear attentively toward sound waves (listen); 14 child writing with pencil in notebook, marks only abstract squiggles not readable text (write); cells 15 and 16 empty cream background. Prioritize precise 4x4 grid alignment and safe cell padding. Output high resolution square image.
prompts.unit2: Use case: illustration-story. Production vocabulary cartoon sprite atlas for primary school children. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal square cells in square canvas. Warm softly painted storybook style, friendly brown-haired children, clean simple objects, uniform pale cream backgrounds. No outer margins, NO grid lines, keep all subjects inside cells with generous 12% padding. No text, no letters, no English answers, no labels, no watermark. High resolution. Row-major order left to right then next row: 1: assortment of simple objects, a toy block, cup and ball (thing); 2: child putting books and pencils neatly into schoolbag (pack); 3: one simple child's carry bag (bag); 4: one straight ruler with tick marks but no numbers (ruler); 5: one white and pink eraser beside faint erased pencil marks (eraser); 6: red ball completely inside an open box (in); 7: child thinking about a mystery object hidden beneath cloth (guess); 8: child delighted to discover lost toy under chair (find); 9: school lost-property shelf with bag umbrella and cap, child reclaiming bag, NO signage (lost and found); 10: one happy young child full body (kid); 11: older child gently caring for younger sister, helping tie shoe (take care of); 12: child pointing toward a distant bag away from feet (there); 13: hand returning a book to original empty shelf space, curved arrow (back); 14: child returning toward waiting friend at doorway, curved arrow (come back). Any remaining cells up to16 must be empty cream. Parenthetical English is guidance only and must not appear in artwork.
